text.offer: You have proven yourself a disciple of Qor. One of our dark casters hungers to walk beside you and feed on your enemies. Ask me for a companion, and they will swear to you in Qor's name.
text.progress: Stand before Qor's priestess and ask her for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
text.complete: Let your enemies wither before you both. The bond between you will deepen with every death you share.

steps.objective: Take a companion into your service
steps.brief: Stand before Qor's priestess and ask her for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
